chapters.reason: The paper explicitly focuses on converting pretrained Transformers into linear recurrent structures (gated recurrent models) using fine-tuning, which is the definition of training-induced hidden-state conversion.
The resulting architecture is a gated linear recurrent model, which falls under the category of linear-state recurrence using matrix-valued hidden states and predetermined update rules.

The approach repurposes existing pretrained weights to facilitate recurrent behavior without adding extra parameters, aligning with the goal of unlocking latent recurrent capabilities in standard architectures.
